Fighter: Need an axe? I'm with you.
Point me at something to hit.
Archer: I don't miss. Point me at a target.
Mage: My spells aren't gentle, but they're effective.
I've studied enough. Time to fight.
Cavalier: I rode from the front lines. Where do you need me?
Cleric: I can mend what's broken. Stay close.
The wounded need me. Lead on.
Myrmidon: I fight alone. But I'll fight beside you.
Thief: I go where I please. Right now, I please to go with you.
Locks, traps, pockets - I handle them all.
Mercenary: Coin's good. Cause is better. You've got both.
Pegasus Knight: The skies are mine. Let's see what's ahead.
From above, I've seen what the corruption does.
Knight: I am the shield. You are the sword.
Dancer: A dance can turn the tide. Watch and see.
Morale wins wars. I'm here for that.
Wyvern Rider: My wyvern and I answer to no lord. But for this fight - we'll make an exception.
Hero: I've fought in darker wars than this. What matters is seeing it through.
Another war. Let's end this one.
Falcon Knight: From above, I've seen what the corruption does. No more.
Lance and sky. That's all I need.
Sage: The old magic is failing. Perhaps your seer can show us a better path.
Knowledge is a weapon. I'm well-armed.
Assassin: I don't do speeches. Just tell me who dies.
Sniper: One shot. One kill. That's the only math that matters.
I see the target. That's enough.
Bishop: The light fades, but it hasn't gone. Not yet.
Healing and faith. I bring both.
Chevalier: My lance rides where honor demands. Lead, and I follow.
A knight without a charge is nothing. Give me one.
Sky Lancer: The wind answers to no one. Neither do I.
From up here, I see everything. Point me at the real threat.
Sentinel: I don't move. I don't flinch. Come at me.
They'll break against me like waves on stone.

Edric: Rally to me. We're stronger together.
Kira: I see the line to win. Do you?
Voss: Still standing. That's all that matters.
Sera: I dreamt of this moment. Stay close.
Rowan: My lance is blessed. My aim? That's all me.
Astrid: The sky sees what the ground misses. I'll be your sight.
Cael: I'll hold the line. Don't have too much fun back there.

runStart.speaker: Sera
runStart.line: I see a path... fragmented, but there. Stay close, Edric.

act1_to_act2.speaker: Sera
act1_to_act2.line: The frontier is behind us. The emperor's forces know we're coming - I can feel the lieutenant watching.

act2_to_act3.speaker: Edric
act2_to_act3.line: The sacred ground ahead is corrupted. The ritual is close. And so is the lieutenant.

act3_to_finalBoss_normal.speaker: Sera
act3_to_finalBoss_normal.line: The lieutenant is near. I can feel their visions pressing against mine. This ends now.

act3_to_act4.speaker: Sera
act3_to_act4.line: The lieutenant is gone, but the corruption hasn't stopped. It's stronger. The ritual - the emperor must have completed it before we-

act4_to_finalBoss.speaker: Edric
act4_to_finalBoss.line: The emperor's stronghold. He thinks he can control what he's awakened. He's wrong.

finalBoss_to_secretAct.speaker: Sera
finalBoss_to_secretAct.line: Wait - the ground is shaking. The ritual fed it too much. It's waking up. We have to go down there. Now.

secretAct_start.speaker: Sera
secretAct_start.line: This place is... wrong. The air doesn't move. Time doesn't pass. It's here.

preBattle.speaker: Iron Captain
preBattle.line: You'll go no further. This border belongs to the empire now.

defeat.speaker: Iron Captain
defeat.line: Impossible... the border was supposed to hold...

preBattle.speaker: Warchief
preBattle.line: Another band of fools. My axe grows thirsty.

defeat.speaker: Warchief
defeat.line: Hah... you fight well. Better than I expected.

preBattle.speaker: Knight Commander
preBattle.line: The emperor's will is absolute. Your little rebellion ends here.

defeat.speaker: Knight Commander
defeat.line: The emperor will hear of this. You've only delayed the inevitable.

preBattle.speaker: Archmage
preBattle.line: I've studied the rifts your prophet creates. Fascinating - and so fragile.

defeat.speaker: Archmage
defeat.line: The rifts... they're stronger than my models predicted...

preBattle.speaker: Blade Lord
preBattle.line: The lieutenant sees all paths. You walk the one that ends in your grave.

defeat.speaker: Blade Lord
defeat.line: You shouldn't be here. The lieutenant said this path was sealed.

preBattle.speaker: Iron Wall
preBattle.line: None have breached these walls. None ever will.

defeat.speaker: Iron Wall
defeat.line: The walls... are nothing... without the will behind them...

preBattle.speaker: The Lieutenant
preBattle.line: I've seen every future you could reach. In all of them, you fall.

defeat.speaker: The Lieutenant
defeat.line: You... found the one path I couldn't block. But it won't matter. My master's work is already done.

preBattle.speaker: The Emperor
preBattle.line: You think you've won something by killing my seer? I don't need visions. I have power.

defeat.speaker: The Emperor
defeat.line: You fools. You have no idea what I was holding back. Without me, there's nothing between you and-

defeat.speaker: Sera
defeat.line: It's... receding. Going back to sleep. We did it. It's over.

preBattle.speaker: Dark Rider
preBattle.line: The shadows ride with me. You cannot outrun the dark.

defeat.speaker: Dark Rider
defeat.line: The darkness... will find another rider...

preBattle.speaker: Berserker King
preBattle.line: Blood and iron! I'll crush you with my bare hands if I have to!

defeat.speaker: Berserker King
defeat.line: Hah... finally... a fight worth dying for...

victory_normal.speaker: Sera
victory_normal.line: The lieutenant has fallen. The visions are clearing... but something deeper still stirs. I can feel it.

victory_hard.speaker: Sera
victory_hard.line: The emperor is defeated. The ritual is broken... mostly. I still see something beneath it all. Sleeping, but not for long.

victory_lunatic.speaker: Sera
victory_lunatic.line: It's going back to sleep. The cycle is broken. For the first time... I can't see what comes next. And that's beautiful.

defeat.speaker: Sera
defeat.line: No... this path leads to ruin. We must try again.

act1: The air tastes of iron here.
Scouts spotted movement ahead.
Something stirs beyond the treeline.
The ground is scarred from old battles.
act2: Imperial banners hang in tatters.
The corruption has touched this place.
Smoke rises from the far ridge.
Old fortifications, hastily rebuilt.
act3: The sky darkens without clouds.
Reality bends at the edges here.
The earth hums with a low, wrong note.
Even the wind sounds uncertain.
act4: The air itself resists each step.
Shadows move against the light.
This land remembers what was done to it.
The corruption runs deep here. Deeper than roots.
finalBoss: The end of the path. One way or another.
Everything converges here.
No more detours. No more preparation.
The world holds its breath.

act1: A stronger presence guards this road.
The scouts fell back. That's never good.
Something here doesn't want to be found.
The usual patrols don't come this way.
act2: An officer commands these troops. Stay sharp.
Imperial elites. Not conscripts — true believers.
This garrison was reinforced recently.
They knew we were coming.
act3: The corruption has champions of its own.
Power radiates from this place. Twisted power.
Whatever guards this place has forgotten mercy.
The air crackles. Not lightning — something older.
act4: A fragment of the emperor's will, given form.
This one was shaped by the ritual itself.
The corruption's finest soldier stands ready.
Even the ground trembles at what waits ahead.
finalBoss: The last guardian. The strongest.
All that power, concentrated in one vessel.
This is the price of the final step.
It knows why we've come.

act1: A commander holds the line ahead.
The border's strongest awaits.
Steel and discipline guard this crossing.
Their leader won't yield ground easily.
act2: The lieutenant's chosen blocks our path.
An imperial champion. Forged in conquest.
This one answers directly to the throne.
Command tents and war banners. A true siege.
act3: The ritual's guardian manifests.
Something ancient defends this ground.
The corruption's vessel awaits us.
Something presses against the edge of perception.
act4: The emperor's inner circle. The last wall.
Power like this shouldn't exist in mortal hands.
This is what the ritual was building toward.
Beyond this, only the emperor himself.
finalBoss: The source of everything. Right here.
All roads led to this moment.
No visions needed to see what comes next.
The world's fate rests on what happens here.

act1: Someone signals from the roadside.
A survivor. Still willing to fight.
Not everyone has given up on this land.
Another blade for the cause.
act2: A deserter from the imperial ranks.
They've seen what the empire really is.
Courage finds strange vessels sometimes.
One more soul choosing the harder path.
act3: Even here, someone still resists.
The corruption hasn't claimed everyone.
A fighter, hardened by what they've survived.
They don't need convincing. They need a direction.
act4: Survival alone takes strength here.
To still fight, this deep in — that's something.
The corruption spat this one out. Their loss.
Another who refused to break.
finalBoss: Even at the end, allies find us.
One last warrior, drawn to the final stand.
They know the odds. They came anyway.
Some debts can only be paid in battle.

Kira: I found the winning line... just not for me.
Don't stop. The path is still there. I can almost see it.
Heh. Thought I'd be the last one standing.
Voss: Still standing... for now. Go. Finish this.
Took more than I expected. Don't waste what's left.
The shield breaks so the sword can strike. Go.
Sera: The visions are fading... but I see you, Edric. You'll find the way.
I couldn't see this path. Maybe that means it's the right one.
The future isn't written yet. Not even I could see this far.
Rowan: My lance... it's blessed. Take it. It'll know your hand.
The sky was beautiful from up there. Keep looking up.
One last charge. Make it count for both of us.
Astrid: I could see so far from up there... not far enough, it seems.
The wind carries on. So should you.
Don't look down. I never did.
Cael: The line holds. Even without me, the line holds.
I said I'd hold. And I did. Now go.
Every wall falls eventually. Build a better one.

act1: The light returns to their eyes, slowly.
A second chance. Don't waste it.
Breath returns. The wound remembers.
act2: The altar's power runs deeper than faith.
Pulled back from the edge. Not gently.
The old prayers still carry weight here.
act3: Even the light struggles against what's coming.
Revival feels different now. Heavier.
The corruption makes the healing harder.
act4: The altar burns brighter, as if in defiance.
Brought back in spite of everything.
Light and dark, balanced on a knife's edge.
finalBoss: One more miracle. Perhaps the last.
The light knows what's at stake.
Restoration, at the world's end.

act1: Growth, earned in blood and resolve.
The change is visible. Sharper. Stronger.
A new chapter begins.
act2: Power awakens where there was only potential.
The battlefield has forged something new.
Ready for what lies ahead. Almost.
The old title falls away. A new one fits better.
act3: Transformation. Not gentle, but necessary.
Stronger now. The corruption demands it.
Ascension in the face of darkness.
act4: Even the altar seems impressed.
The power to face what's coming. Finally.
Reborn for the final march.
finalBoss: The ultimate form. For the ultimate battle.
Everything they were, refined to a point.
One last evolution. Make it matter.

act1: The merchant eyes your coin purse hopefully.
Frontier goods. Honest prices. Mostly.
Stock up while you can. The road only gets harder.
act2: Imperial supply lines make for good scavenging.
The merchant has seen better days. Haven't we all.
War is terrible for everything except business.
act3: The wares have a strange shimmer to them here.
Even merchants feel the corruption. The prices reflect it.
Take what you need. Gold won't matter if we fail.
act4: How this merchant survives here is its own mystery.
Rare goods, for those who've made it this far.
The merchant nods. No words needed at this point.
finalBoss: Last chance to prepare. Choose wisely.
The merchant's hands tremble as they lay out the wares.
Everything has a price. Especially what comes next.

act1: The stronger ones fall. The road opens.
That was no ordinary patrol.
A harder fight. A harder-won peace.
act2: The empire's best, and it wasn't enough.
Their commander fell. The rest will scatter.
Imperial elite. Now imperial dead.
act3: The corruption's champion is broken.
Power like that, and still it fell.
The darkness loses a champion today.
act4: The emperor's inner guard, shattered.
That was a fragment of his will. Now it's dust.
Closer to the source. The resistance weakens.
finalBoss: The last obstacle, overcome.
Nothing stands between us and the end now.
The final guardian falls.
